description: Export a bot's trade history as structured data — every closed trade with entry/exit prices and P&L, plus a performance summary. Use it to review or report on how a specific bot has performed. Read-only. Get bot IDs from list_bots.

format.description: "summary" = performance stats plus recent trades (default); "full" = every trade the bot has made.

id.description: The bot ID whose trades to export, obtained from list_bots.

name: export_bot_trades
